about.en: Vaxcyte, Inc. is a US clinical-stage vaccine innovation company listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market that develops conjugate vaccines against serious bacterial infections using a cell-free protein synthesis platform. Its lead candidates are the pneumococcal conjugate vaccines VAX-31 and VAX-24, alongside programs targeting Group A Strep and Shigella. In tokenized and derivative markets, PCVX is the reference equity for products tracking Vaxcyte shares.
